    Personal Loan Interest Rates 2026

     

    Interest rate of a Personal Loan refers to the annual cost of borrowing funds. Lenders set these rates based on various factors, including creditworthiness and market conditions. If you are looking for a favourable Personal Loan interest rate, it is important to maintain a good credit score and a stable financial profile. Borrowers can use Personal Loan Interest Rate Calculators to estimate their monthly repayments. Personal Loan interest rates play a crucial role in determining the overall cost of the loan; borrowers should compare the rates and choose the most favourable option for their financial needs. ICICI Bank offers Personal Loans with competitive interest rates starting at 9.99%* per annum.

    Factors that affect Personal Loan interest rates

    Personal Loan interest rates are determined after evaluating several financial and personal factors to assess repayment ability and overall risk. These factors play an important role in deciding the final Personal Loan interest rate offered to an applicant.

     

    1. Stable Employment: A steady job and regular income are important factors. Applicants with stable employment are often seen as lower risk, which can positively influence the rate offered.
    2. Strong Credit Profile: Credit history plays a key role in determining the interest rate. A good credit score reflects responsible repayment behaviour and financial discipline. This increases the chances of being offered a more favourable rate.
    3. Existing Debt: Banks check ongoing loans and monthly repayments to understand financial pressure. A lower debt-to-income ratio improves the chances of approval for a Personal Loan.
    4. Income Level: Consistent and sufficient income supports repayment ability. Higher and stable income  can positively influence loan approval and may help in securing a more favourable interest rate.

    Along with these factors, market conditions and bank policies also affect pricing.

    Maintaining a stable financial profile can help borrowers access a favourable interest rate on a Personal Loan and better repayment terms.

     

    How to Calculate Personal Loan EMI

    • Personal Loan EMIs are calculated using the loan amount, interest rate and repayment tenure.
    • The EMI is determined using factors such as principal amount, monthly interest rate and number of instalments.
    • A Personal Loan EMI Calculator can help estimate monthly EMI and total repayment amount instantly.
    • Applicants can adjust the loan amount and tenure to understand different repayment scenarios.
    • Factors such as credit score, income stability, repayment history and existing liabilities may influence the final interest rate offered.

    ICICI Bank Personal Loan interest rates start from 9.99% p.a., subject to eligibility and internal assessment.

    Personal Loan Interest Rates FAQs

    What is ICICI Bank Personal Loan interest rate?

    ICICI Bank Personal Loan interest rates start from 9.99% p.a. and may vary based on factors such as income, credit profile, repayment history, employer category and existing relationship with the Bank. Applicants with a healthy CIBIL score, stable income and lower existing liabilities may be eligible for lower interest Personal Loans and affordable EMIs. The final interest rate is determined after internal assessment and eligibility evaluation. 

    How are the Personal Loan interest rates calculated?

    The bank adds 1/12th of the annual rate of interest for each month to the remaining loan amount. Customers are supposed to make monthly payments towards their principal amount plus this amount to pay off their loans.

    Is the Personal Loan interest rate fixed or floating?

    ICICI Bank offers a fixed Personal Loan interest rate. It means the rate of interest stays constant throughout the tenure and does not change as per the market movements.

    How can I get the low interest rate on a Personal Loan?

    To get the lowest interest rate, you can improve your credit score, apply for a Joint Loan with a co-applicant and opt for a shorter loan tenure. For more information, please connect with us.

    Does ICICI Bank provide a special Personal Loan interest rate for Salary Account holders?

    There is no separate ICICI Bank Personal Loan rate of interest for a Salary Account exclusively, as they enjoy the same attractive rates and seamless benefits as all customers. Salary Account holders can apply for a Personal Loan of up to ₹50 lakh at a fixed interest rate starting at 9.99% p.a., with a 100% digital process that ensures fairness and transparency. 

    Can I switch to a different interest rate type during the loan tenure?

    Switching between fixed and floating interest rates during the loan tenure depends on the bank’s current policies. However, ICICI Bank only offers a fixed interest rate for Personal Loans.

    How can I estimate my EMI based on interest rates?

    You can use the ICICI Bank’s Personal Loan EMI Calculator available on the website to calculate your EMIs quickly. The usage is simple, enter the loan amount, interest rate, and tenure to get the repayment estimate in seconds.

    Is 9.99% a good interest rate on a Personal Loan?

    Yes, 9.99% is a good interest rate. It depends on the borrower's credit profile and the bank’s Terms and Conditions. Please review specific interest rates and applicable charges before applying.

    What is the difference between part payment, prepayment and pre-closure? 

    The difference between part payment, prepayment and pre-closure is as follows:

    • Part payment: Paying a portion of your outstanding loan balance before your loan repayment date.

    • Prepayment: Paying off the entire remaining balance before your loan repayment date. It could include a prepayment penalty.

    • Pre-closure: When you pay off the loan with the outstanding principal at once, it may often include a penalty.

    Do ICICI Bank charge GST on Personal Loan?

    Yes, applicable GST may be charged on Personal Loan processing fees, foreclosure charges and other service-related charges as per prevailing tax regulations.

    What is the interest on a ₹5 lakh Personal Loan?

    The interest payable on a ₹5 lakh Personal Loan depends on the applicable interest rate, repayment tenure and EMI structure selected during loan application.

    Is Personal Loan interest charged monthly?

    Yes, Personal Loan interest is generally calculated monthly and included in the EMI payable throughout the selected repayment tenure.

    What is the interest rate for unsecured Personal Loans?

    Unsecured Personal Loan interest rates vary depending on credit score, income profile, repayment history and the lender’s internal assessment criteria.

    What is a good interest rate for a Personal Loan?

    A competitive Personal Loan interest rate usually depends on factors such as CIBIL score, stable income and overall creditworthiness of the applicant.
